Skyrim's '''main quest''' consists of seventeen required quests and two optional quests. During these quests you discover your heritage as the [[Skyrim:Dovahkiin|Dovahkiin]], learn why [[Skyrim:Dragon|dragons]] have returned to the world, and find a way to respond to the dragon threat. Completing the main quest will take approximately 15-30 hours depending on your character's level. Eight [[Skyrim:Achievements|achievements]] (170 points; 7 Bronze and 1 Gold) are directly tied to completing the main quest; in addition, several [[Skyrim:Dragon Shouts#Achievements|dragon shout]]-related achievements are inevitably unlocked during the quests. Quests belonging to the main quest are marked in your journal by the dragon head knotwork, which is pictured above.
